fluff.overview: Most Clan infantry are solahma warriors at the end of their careers or who have failed their Trials, assigned to duties the warrior caste considers beneath notice. Motorized Points ride light vehicles or motorcycles that provide faster movement than foot infantry without the heavier logistical requirements of fully mechanized formations. They trade protection for speed, making them effective as screening forces and rapid-response elements but vulnerable when caught in sustained engagements. Support troops carry man-portable flamers that project streams of burning chemicals, providing devastating area-effect capability against infantry and structures at the cost of short range and the vulnerability of the operator's fuel tank.
